content: ADK LlmAgent with output_key stores agent final text response in session state under that key (via output_key='confidence_map'). For JSON output without tools: use response_mime_type='application/json' in generate_content_config (same as cleaning_agent pattern). Cannot combine output_schema with tools. Verification agent has no tools so response_mime_type=application/json is safe (Pitfall 4 only applies to tool-calling agents). Session state accessed in instructions via {key} template substitution — e.g. {cleaned_transcription} injects the stored JSON string. Critical: always read session state via session_service.get_session() AFTER run completes, never from session.state directly during run. Add verification_agent as 4th entry in SequentialAgent.sub_agents.
